title: Conflicting verification receipts for the same bundle

incident.summary: Two receipts for the same semantic_hash disagree: one reports COMPUTATIONALLY_SUPPORTED, another REJECTED.
indicators: Different verifier digests in receipt metadata

must_not: Pick the favorable receipt without investigation
